title: Latency Orchestra: unified route/model p50/p95/p99 panels with streaming vs non-streaming conductor
creator: Ava Thompson
description: Create a consolidated dashboard ('Latency Orchestra') that surfaces p50/p95/p99 latency by model and route with an explicit split for streaming vs non-streaming IO modes. This ticket covers the dashboard design, telemetry queries, tracing hook adjustments to emit stream-awareness tags, and metric/log pipeline transforms required to support efficient percentile computation and cohort slicing by request shape. Goal: give SREs and product teams a single-pane view to detect SLO regressions, diagnose streaming regressions, and validate rollout policies.
comments: 2025-11-12 - Ava Thompson: Kickoff - defined scope: dashboard panels + metric transforms + tracing hook tag. Agreed to avoid adding raw trace sampling changes in this ticket; we'll rely on existing sampling config.

2025-11-13 - Priya Shah (PM): Confirmed user stories: (1) investigate p95 spikes per route, (2) compare stream vs sync latency for given model, (3) link to traces/PRs from plateaus. Prioritize trace links for p99 anomalies.

2025-11-15 - Marco Diaz: Implemented initial prometheus-style histogram export for tokenized-response-latency. Created branch rdx/observability/latency-orchestra. Added stream_mode tag on servepath span and http_request metrics.

2025-11-18 - Lena Müller (SRE): Reviewed queries; requested adding request_shape and conversation_length as optional cohorts. Noted high-cardinality risk for model+route+shape+len; recommended pre-aggregations.

acceptance_criteria: Dashboard surfaces p50, p95, p99 for every model x route combination for the last 7 days
Each panel has a toggle to view streaming-only, non-streaming-only, or combined metrics
Panels include link-to-trace functionality: clicking an anomalous segment opens the trace viewer filtered to that servepath/span
Metric pipeline includes stream_mode boolean tag on latency metrics and a pre-aggregation layer to keep cardinality tractable
SRE/PM can create a saved view that isolates request_shape cohorts and conversation_length buckets
Query latency across dashboard panels returns within 8s for typical 7-day range (system performance target)
steps_taken: Added stream_mode boolean to servepath spans and http_request metrics in runtime (runtimes/servepath/instrumentation change)
Implemented histogram export for tokenized response latency with explicit bucket boundaries aligned to p50/p95/p99 targets
Created telemetry transform to materialize 1h window aggregates grouped by model, route, stream_mode, request_shape_bucket and conversation_length_bucket
Built Grafana panels: 'Orchestra Overview', 'Model x Route Matrix', 'Streaming Gap Waterfall', each with drilldown links to traces
Ran load test for metric aggregation on staging (10k rps synthetic) to validate pre-aggregation and query latency
next_steps: Finish dashboard styling and add annotations for recent deploy rollouts
Create an alert rule for p95 regressions by route with automatic trace links and incident template
Coordinate with Data Pipeline team to schedule daily rollup job in production (ENG-260123 dependency)
Run a two-week canary on Dedicated region eu-west-1 to validate streaming/non-streaming separation under real traffic
Document query patterns and short guide for PMs/SREs in Confluence
